messages:
Implement JSON Patch (RFC 6902) applyPatch

Add applyPatch(document, patch) to src/index.ts, covering all six
operations (add, remove, replace, move, copy, test). Built on the
existing resolvePointer to validate targets/sources, deep-clones the
document so callers' inputs are never mutated, and clones on copy so
copied subtrees never alias their source.
